scoring: Future fact layer. Preserving the bytes in T1 does not pass these judgments and is not a user-ready product.
rejected_directions: folder copy treated as a complete export
future_sequence: preserve every original in this package
overview answers for the cases below
open the cited original in one step
reimport every original plus the renamed byte-identical copy
export a complete or explicitly partial copy

future_judgment.monthly: Northline Video personal account has two monthly amount-paid statements, September and October 2026, USD 15.99 each. Collecting every later month is not required.
future_judgment.yearly: Paperlantern Cloud has yearly amount-paid statements of USD 107.91 for service through 2027-02-28.
future_judgment.as_of_review_date: On 2026-11-14 the October service period has ended. That does not by itself make the current status expired. Current status is unknown unless a later sourced statement says otherwise.
must_not: treat September and October as one purchase because the amounts match
mark the video service currently expired only because 2026-10-31 is before 2026-11-14
require a credential for every missing month

future_judgment.keep_separate: Same merchant, same amount, same service period, and same issue date stay two accounts because the account emails differ.
must_not: merge the personal and work accounts by merchant similarity
merge them because both say Amount paid USD 107.91

source_quotes.text: perpetual seat for one person to use Lumen Draft 4 on up to two devices they personally operate. Not transferable. No subscription term.

future_judgment.path: One-time purchase evidence. The license range is the original wording in the quote, not a subscription period and not a warranty record.
must_not: widen the written seat and device limit because money was paid
invent a renewal date
store a license-key field that the document does not contain

source_quotes.text: This Total is a credit-note total, not an amount paid.
Receipt of the refund is not stated.

future_judgment.refund: The credit note records a refund statement of USD 15.99. It does not prove the refund was received.
future_judgment.paid: The October receipt remains an amount-paid statement of USD 15.99.
must_not: treat the unique Total as amount paid
erase the October amount-paid statement because a credit note exists
replace both facts with a single net amount

source_quotes.text: This Total is an order total whose payment nature is not stated.

future_judgment.order_total: USD 99.00 is an order total of unjudged payment nature. It is not amount paid and it does not conflict with the invoice.
must_not: call the order Total amount paid
open an amount conflict only because 99.00 differs from 107.91 on the invoice

source_quotes.text: This document states the service period above and no status after 2023-12-31.

future_judgment.sentence: The invoice states service through 2023-12-31. Status after that is unconfirmed.
future_judgment.as_of_review_date: 2026-11-14 is after the stated period. Current status stays unknown.
must_not: mark the service currently expired only because the stated period is in the past
use the import timestamp as an observation date

source_quotes.text: This notice does not say the service ended on the notice date.

future_judgment.usability: Cancelling automatic renewal leaves the service usable through the stated 2027-02-28 date. It is not an immediate end on 2026-10-20.
must_not: treat renewal cancellation as already unusable
invent a current expired status from the notice date

source_quotes.text: This notice does not say which account owns the masked email.

future_judgment.assignment: The masked address is unassigned. It may be shown as an unassigned notice that could concern a Paperlantern account, without changing either account until a person decides.
must_not: assign the notice to mira.ellison.example because the local part starts with j
assign the notice to jordan.hale.example because the merchant matches
treat merchant or sender similarity as an account link

source_quotes.text: The charged cell is 99.00 and conflicts with invoice amount paid 107.91 for the same order.

future_judgment.conflict: For work-account order SYN-C-WORK-2026-031, the CSV charged cell USD 99.00 conflicts with the invoice amount paid USD 107.91. Do not pick a winner automatically.
future_judgment.not_part_of_conflict: The order confirmation Total USD 99.00 stays an unjudged order total and does not join this conflict.
must_not: auto-adopt 99.00 or 107.91 as the single paid amount
split the quoted CSV field on the comma inside annual plan, store export row

future_judgment.reimport: Importing every original again, plus this renamed copy, records a new occurrence for the batch and does not create a purchase from the byte match.
future_judgment.human_edit: A committed human decision on a source remains after reimport. The renamed September file is the same bytes as originals/v-2026-09-receipt.pdf under a different path and file name.
future_judgment.storage: Identical bytes reuse stored bytes. Path and file name are not identity.
must_not: mint a purchase id from the content hash
overwrite the human decision because the file was imported again
merge distinct purchases or entitlements because the bytes matched

cases.t1_observable_subset: T1 may show storage reuse, a new occurrence, a stable source id that is not the hash, and an unchanged committed user_marker. T1 does not implement the human decision or entitlement model; the marker is only committed metadata.
